purpose: 4職の96px戦闘素材を依頼者原画から再作成。歩行素材は不変。

entries.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create production PIXEL ART battle sprites from the supplied owner's original four-character warrior reference. Exactly 4 ROWS x 3 COLUMNS, twelve separate full-body sprites, 3-head-tall proportions. Every sprite comfortably fits its own equal cell with 20 percent transparent padding on ALL sides; no edge touches, no clipping, no contact between sprites or adjacent rows. IMPORTANT: smaller figures within generous canvas margins, especially rightmost column. Canvas portrait approximately 1536x2048. True transparent background, no labels, text, grid, floor or detached shadows. Row1 Kaina blue-haired man, row2 Rione auburn ponytail woman, row3 Haldo silver-haired man, row4 Suina long violet-haired woman. Preserve each face, hair and exact costume from reference. silver armor, red capes, sword and shield. Keep swords compact and close to each body, diagonal downward while standing and compact forward thrust while attacking. All face LEFT in a three-quarter battle stance. Columns: 1 idle ready, 2 distinct attack, 3 distinct hurt recoil. Keep scale and boots' ground level consistent across each row. Rich but controlled natural colors, crisp detailed pixel clusters, expressive large eyes, intended for 96x96 pixel game frames. This is newly redrawn larger artwork, not enlargement of previous low-resolution sprites. No commercial game content.
entries.selection_basis: 短めの剣を構えた案。大きく剣を振り出す最初の案は不採用。
